{{Top}}
[[File:ToArms-TCGEoD.jpg|thumb|right|300px|[[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] retrieve weapons from the armory]]
An '''armory''' was a room or area where weapons and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] were stored.

==History==
Prior to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] armory, which included [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] lore, was discovered in the jungles of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="TotJ Comp">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]] [[Clone military education complex|Military Complex]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] house several weapon armories<ref name="ARCT">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref> as well as the [[Central Armory/Legends|Central Armory]], where where [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] received their [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> During the [[First Battle of Kamino]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] forces overran the area. Following the devastation wrought by the Clone Wars, an [[Project Another Chance|initiative]] was begun by the [[Alderaanian/Legends|inhabitants]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to disarm themselves and devote their [[Planet/Legends|world]] to peace.<ref name="Corla DB">{{DB|character|corlametonae|Metonae, Corla}}</ref> The [[Alderaanian War Frigate]] ''[[Another Chance]]'' was converted into a mobile armory and programmed to make random hyperspace jumps across the galaxy.<ref name="GoA">''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]''</ref>
